title: Adoption runs hot on the new versions
description: 5 versions × 6 features · shade = % of accounts using it · every cell carries its number

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered releases and their adoption percentages, indexed by features. Null, negative, over-100 and nonfinite values are unavailable; zero is a real, labelled cell.

props.name: features
props.description: Ordered feature labels for the columns; repeated names remain separate indexed categories.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
